## Design Settings » Footer Design
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046628

## Footer Design
This article reviews all the settings available to edit the Footer of the Website. To access this section navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
General
Footer Design

## Visual Guide of the Footer Design
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626445/original/fUIGRfl6ELgb0qRo-4hR977EJjQu6rpYLw.png?1759862556 | alt: ]

## 1. Display Footer
This setting will hide or display the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626494/original/Bn1Q_J9Vm6HmQhiQsjwIh4nAfCKQQCkzag.png?1759862592 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099358/original/4Z22oEw9JkGSvf0-4UzCAYmpxLHyKA5C8A.png?1699393657 | alt: ]

## 2. Background Color
This setting controls the background color of the website
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626514/original/pY8ERPTOKlT6GwbfbB406SEUpV9oMzwWxg.png?1759862612 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099528/original/vUauyRYTnObSQ1nAItggT2iNEpnU4UX8lA.png?1699393817 | alt: ]

## 3. Section Title Color
This setting controls the color of the Sections Title in the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626523/original/6zo4XZpMF-8dbigaAr1abq1lf7CwSV7x9g.png?1759862633 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099747/original/aEERXDI3cjeC4O6YVuQV07sAaLLcO1flyA.png?1699393983 | alt: ]

## 4. Font & Link Color
This setting controls the color of the Font and the Links in the footer of the website
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626541/original/s57wrnYGI0qmB5uEqtrJ97j1REk5B2ibig.png?1759862653 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099791/original/jeICgc-XsXdqIlrVm52cOPyaHqyme6l62w.png?1699394067 | alt: ]

## 5. Link Hover Color
This setting controls the hover color of links in the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626545/original/JR6IP7w8XCHmOXnlQRVH_AybhHoP58vApQ.png?1759862674 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099950/original/_Ae1Bf0yqFsMDcZLiDlaJK_rUMXDFnhdUA.png?1699394207 | alt: ]

## 6. Signup Button Background
This setting controls the background color for the signup button in the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626557/original/nYHbgXWFF7_ssuuRYXPbZgonpDj76upvBw.png?1759862704 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134099974/original/qFF97a05vJ0VrN3z4eiLldGJZDtWURQKuw.png?1699394274 | alt: ]

## 7. Signup Button Font Color
This setting controls the color of the font of the sign up button, in the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626568/original/FIr6dft1blLuxaSW7uSS9DQCvulZW3Am6w.png?1759862718 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134100552/original/opA2yCQfaM2GTLPLMNqcvw9EQk2xV5AG6w.png?1699394912 | alt: ]

## 8. Display Social Icons
This setting controls if the Social Icons are displayed or not.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627280/original/SpAOmF_DWW5MKDkI0ScDQ5BobQYw-ffvbQ.png?1759863285 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627401/original/LsuRNTzd6dJ-jW2BXhmPjLEFYCCxUBLY-g.png?1759863472 | alt: ]

[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627604/original/EGRBojwOULTvpKvAl2nvhq834aau4bmTQA.png?1759863572 | alt: ]

## 9. Social Icons Style
This setting controls the style of the Social Icons.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627293/original/J8VNIGt3iLTCq3bSf45cVFn0PFVvj1N80w.png?1759863303 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627550/original/99ytIJ1Prh-oexWGIjkR6zYWGL85wkM-EQ.png?1759863528 | alt: ]

[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168627505/original/kv1-5sPEOEJ8gSgv1ztkcaYMqR3xkl9YHA.png?1759863518 | alt: ]

## Footer Newsletter Bar
This section of settings controls the Newsletter Bar that displays on top of the footer of the website.

## 10. Display Newsletter Form
This setting controls if the newsletter subscription form is hidden or displayed on the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626639/original/-yKfdU8vrjgHgSAM2Q9--S8lnxJI9NQRow.png?1759862773 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134101916/original/VoZvuO96llKn4YTX0l2EDujStdzM0F2F3A.png?1699396581 | alt: ]

## 11. Newsletter Bar Background
This setting controls the background color of the newsletter bar, that displays on top of the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626648/original/Gkl6acKpT6M3tFoH70J1VosFFJ4HZQE0Ww.png?1759862792 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134102044/original/ZxBbOeS9KtiNrnNCCrG9rxNYvgzQsNn-8w.png?1699396714 | alt: ]

## 12. Button Background
This setting controls the button background color that is used in the Newsletter Bar that displays on top of the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626666/original/c1sTBI4qjSjdscclQ0XfSxqibFxu4r7U4g.png?1759862810 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134102178/original/pPf8g-tk2a70_-ZzKqH-GylP0YhPM9M2cg.png?1699396915 | alt: ]

## 13. Button Font Color
This setting controls the color of the font of the button used on the Newsletter Bar that displays on top of the footer of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168626780/original/yJ2_4wMaVJdNYzxEgtBfijpzbcTCkeOmfg.png?1759862826 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134102293/original/INV-eTns6ozyzUbMoNTPTOsgzrw6hISmHQ.png?1699397034 | alt: ]
